entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION C—-DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015
entries.text:
Sec. 8116.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
in contravention of the War Powers Resolution (50 U.S.C. 1541 et seq.).

[[Page 128 STAT. 2281]]
